irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.subject: FDJ-GR0001 (Factory Direct Jewelry — Lab Grown Diamond Halo Engagement Ring in 14K Gold)
irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.finding: Displays 'Made with solid gold. Never plated.', 'Karat stamped inside the band.', and default 'Weight:1.25 Grams' alongside 'Total Carat Weight: 1.37cts' (0.274 g diamond mass). If gross weight, net 14K alloy mass is just 0.976 g ($73.67 melt at $4,024.45/oz) — extreme structural thin-band fragility risk corroborated by unaccredited BBB profile (1.8/5 across 5 reviews; 11 complaints including snapped bands and 20% alteration restocking fee).

irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.subject: SAR-144773 & Sarraf Jewelry Inc. Policy Cross-Check
irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.finding: Three verbatim internal inconsistencies caught across sarraf.com: (1) Product return tab states engraved rings may be returned less $25 fee, whereas /about-sarraf/ restricts 30-day refunds to 'non-engraved items'; (2) Warranty repair deductible reads '$100.00 or 10%' on diamond ring pages vs '$50.00 or 5%' on 10K band pages and BBB filings; (3) Size-10 benchmark metal weights (e.g. 13.40 g on SAR-144773 = $1,011.39 melt, 74.26% of US$1,362.00) weigh less in smaller finger sizes (10.1–10.2 g reported by buyer local jeweler checks) and BBB customer reviews average 2.33/5 (3 reviews) despite A+ BBB Accreditation since 1998.

irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.subject: Automic Gold Set-Stone 'Item Weight' vs Stone-Free Metal Weight
irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.finding: Automic Gold stone-free bands (AG-COFFIN-RING 6.1g 14K, AG-24K 11g 24K) publish pure metal weight, whereas gemstone rings publish gross 'Item Weight: Approximately 2.7g (gold)' (AG-PETAL, 0.6ct = 0.12g stone -> ~2.58g metal) and 'Item Weight: Approximately 1.2g (gold)' (AG-NATURAL 0.10ct, AG-SAPPHIRE-RING 3mm sapphire). Treating gross item weight as pure alloy weight slightly overstates fine gold unless stone carat mass (1 ct = 0.200 g) is separated.

irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.subject: Auvere 22K 'Approximate Fine Weight' Range Wording
irregularities_caught_2026_10_23.finding: Auvere publishes size-dependent ranges labeled 'Approximate Fine Weight:5 to 6.1 grams depending on size' (AV-BRIDGE) and '2.8 to 3.7 grams depending on size' (AV-CLEAN) without clarifying whether 'Fine Weight' means 22K alloy mass (91.67% gold) or 999 fine-gold mass, and without assigning a single default size weight.
